title: ha.mr: a URL shortener with no backend, compresses the URL itself using Huffman

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: PAMR shrinks links without storing them in a back-end database. Instead, it compresses the URL itself, stripping common patterns, matching domains against Huffmancoded dictionaries, then packing the remainder into a compact character set. For QR codes, it switches to QR's alpha numeric mode to reduce encoding overhead. Everything runs in the browser.
